direction.zh-CN: 文本方向，可选 ltr 或 rtl。未传时继承外层 ConfigProvider，最外层默认为 ltr。
direction.en-US: Text direction: ltr or rtl. Inherited from the outer ConfigProvider when omitted, and ltr at the outermost level.

getPopupContainer.zh-CN: 返回弹层容器的函数，只影响仍通过 Portal 渲染的 Modal、SideSheet、ImagePreview，容器需要设置 position: relative。未传时继承外层，最外层为 document.body。
getPopupContainer.en-US: Function returning the popup container. It only affects Modal, SideSheet and ImagePreview, which still render through a Portal; the container needs position: relative. Inherited from the outer ConfigProvider when omitted, and document.body at the outermost level.

locale.zh-CN: 多语言配置，优先级高于 LocaleProvider。未传时继承外层 ConfigProvider；没有 ConfigProvider 设置时由 LocaleProvider 决定，两者都没有时使用 zh_CN。传 null 清除外层的 locale。
locale.en-US: Locale configuration, which takes precedence over LocaleProvider. Inherited from the outer ConfigProvider when omitted; when no ConfigProvider sets it, LocaleProvider decides, and zh_CN is used without either. Pass null to clear the outer locale.

responsiveMap.zh-CN: 自定义响应式断点，key 为 xs、sm、md、lg、xl、xxl，value 为 media query 字符串。按内容比较，内联写对象不会重新注册监听；未传时继承外层，最外层使用 defaultResponsiveMap。
responsiveMap.en-US: Custom responsive breakpoints: keys are xs, sm, md, lg, xl and xxl, values are media query strings. Compared by content, so an inline object does not re-register listeners. Inherited from the outer ConfigProvider when omitted, and defaultResponsiveMap at the outermost level.

responsiveObserve.zh-CN: 是否开启响应式断点监听。关闭时不注册任何 matchMedia 监听；开启后在首次订阅时注册，无订阅时注销。未传时继承外层，最外层为 false。
responsiveObserve.en-US: Whether to observe responsive breakpoints. When off, no matchMedia listener is registered; when on, listeners are registered on the first subscription and removed when none remain. Inherited from the outer ConfigProvider when omitted, and false at the outermost level.

timeZone.zh-CN: 时间类组件使用的时区：数字（距 UTC 的小时偏移）、GMT±HH:MM 字符串或 IANA 标识。数字和 GMT 写法是全年固定的偏移。未传时继承外层。
timeZone.en-US: Time zone for time components: a number (hour offset from UTC), a GMT±HH:MM string or an IANA identifier. Numbers and GMT strings are fixed offsets all year. Inherited from the outer ConfigProvider when omitted.

children.zh-CN: 受该配置影响的内容。显式传入的 direction 与外层不同时（含最外层），内容外包一层带 dir 属性的 div。
children.en-US: Content affected by the configuration. When an explicitly passed direction differs from the outer one, including at the outermost level, the content is wrapped in a div carrying the dir attribute.

children.zh-CN: 参数为当前生效配置（ContextValue）的 snippet；在 ConfigProvider 内还包含 screens 与 onBreakpoint，没有 ConfigProvider 时为空对象。
children.en-US: Snippet receiving the effective configuration (ContextValue). Inside a ConfigProvider it also holds screens and onBreakpoint; without a ConfigProvider it is an empty object.
